title: Tiny, cute bell
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='bellBody' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE066'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#FFC61A'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#E08A00'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <g>
    <!-- handle/loop -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='20' r='7' fill='none' stroke='#FFD84D' stroke-width='5'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='20' r='7' fill='none' stroke='#FFEFA8' stroke-width='2'/>
    <!-- bell body -->
    <path d='M50 26 C30 30 22 48 20 66 L80 66 C78 48 70 30 50 26 Z' fill='url(#bellBody)'/>
    <!-- lower lip / rim -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='30' ry='8' fill='#FFD84D'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='30' ry='7' fill='#FFE87A'/>
    <!-- highlight -->
    <path d='M36 38 C32 44 31 52 32 58' fill='none' stroke='#FFF6C2' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- clapper -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='74' r='6' fill='#E08A00'/>
    <circle cx='48' cy='72' r='2' fill='#FFEFA8'/>
    <!-- base band -->
    <rect x='34' y='60' width='32' height='4' rx='2' fill='#FF9E1A'/>
  </g>
</svg>
